name: Eau de Paris tariff jurisdiction
authority: Conseil d'administration d'Eau de Paris, by annual délibération, and the Conseil de Paris
note: Three of the ten volumetric lines on a Paris water bill are set elsewhere and collected by Eau de Paris: the SAP and the SIAAP for wastewater, and the Agence de l'eau Seine-Normandie for its levies. The tariff jurisdiction is Eau de Paris because the bill is Eau de Paris's; the rates on it are not all its own, and the catalogue says so on its face.
